meta.title: Nextal HR & Payroll Enterprise System — Complete Architecture & Workflow Specification
meta.description: Comprehensive mapping of Nextal UAE HR & Payroll platform across Client UI, Middleware Gateway, HR Onboarding, Time & Attendance, Statutory Payroll, Offboarding, and PostgreSQL Invariant Enforcement layers.

lanes.label: Client Presentation & UI Layer
lanes.description: Next.js 14 App Router, Dual LTR/RTL Language Context, React Query State Management & Mobile Responsive Shell

lanes.label: API Gateway, Auth & Tenant Routing
lanes.description: Express.js REST Gateway, JWT Session Lifecycle, AsyncLocalStorage Tenant Isolation & Dynamic Rate Limiting

lanes.label: Employee Lifecycle & Onboarding
lanes.description: Sequential Code Provisioning, Creator Guard Dual-Control Verification, Versioned Contracts & Bank Validation (T27)

lanes.label: Time, Attendance & Overtime Engine
lanes.description: Biometric Punch Ingestion, SHA-256 Deduplication (T4), Asia/Dubai Day Bounds, Missing Punch Queue & Dual Signoff

lanes.label: Statutory Payroll & WPS Engine
lanes.description: 17 Statutory Salary Rules, 5% Variance Detection, Ministry of Human Resources WPS SIF Generation & Final Settlement

lanes.label: Offboarding, Gratuity & Clearance
lanes.description: UAE Labour Law Article 51/52 Gratuity Formulas, Multi-Department Clearance & Employee Archival (T36)

lanes.label: Database, Audit & Triggers (PostgreSQL)
lanes.description: Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL Immutability Triggers, Atomic Transactions & Chronological Audit Trail

phases.label: 1. Ingress & Identity
phases.description: User authentication, JWT issuance, tenant binding, and role-based route guard

phases.label: 2. Employee Provisioning
phases.description: Dual-control hiring, statutory document verification, and bank IBAN MOD-97 checks

phases.label: 3. Biometric & Time Engine
phases.description: Biometric machine import, anomaly remediation, overtime classification, and monthly signoff

phases.label: 4. Payroll Calculation & WPS
phases.description: Statutory rule calculation, variance analysis, salary locking, and WPS SIF generation

phases.label: 5. Offboarding & Audit
phases.description: Gratuity settlement calculation, asset clearance, account archival, and immutable audit logs

nodes.label: Auth & Self-Service Portal
nodes.description: Responsive client shell with LanguageContext (ar/en, KaTeX/RTL), AuthContext (session watcher), and VisaContext

nodes.label: JWT Auth & Session Verification
nodes.description: Enforces 8-hour HTTP-only JWT session, token_version revocation, 5-attempt lockout, and guest optionalAuthenticate on /auth/me

nodes.label: AsyncLocalStorage Tenant Scope
nodes.description: Guarantees complete multi-company data isolation via companyStorage, injecting company_id and visa scope to all Prisma queries

nodes.label: Onboarding Wizard (5 Steps)
nodes.description: HR Officer enters identity details; generates sequential employee code (EMP-DXB-XXX) and assigns statutory visa entity

nodes.label: Dual-Control HR Verification
nodes.description: Enforces segregation of duties (Creator Guard): creator cannot approve own entry; advances status Pre-Joined -> New Joined

nodes.label: Contract v1 & Bank IBAN (T27)
nodes.description: Payroll Officer inputs gross package with statutory basic/housing/transport split; validates ISO-7064 MOD-97 UAE IBAN

nodes.label: Statutory Activation Guard
nodes.description: Activation to Active blocked if bank account, contract, or compliance documents missing; triggers self-service invite

nodes.label: Biometric Punch Ingestion (T4)
nodes.description: Uploads CSV/XLSX machine punches; enforces SHA-256 duplicate file rejection; maps UNKNOWN-DEV-999 to device directory

nodes.label: Attendance Anomaly Remediation
nodes.description: 31-day Asia/Dubai (UTC+4) grid; unresolved punches route to queue with mandatory justification; employee /me request flow

nodes.label: Statutory Overtime Engine (T10)
nodes.description: Calculates Normal OT (1.25x), Night OT (1.50x), Holiday OT (1.50x), Substitute Days; unapproved OT rolls forward at cut-off

nodes.label: Dual Monthly Attendance Sign-Off
nodes.description: Stage 1: Dept Manager confirms team punches; Stage 2: HR Officer marks payroll-ready (HrConfirmed). Unconfirmed teams held (T34)

nodes.label: Statutory Payroll Engine (17 Rules)
nodes.description: Executes 17 statutory salary rules sequence-first: Basic, Housing, Transport, OT additions, Loan/Advance recovery, Absence deductions

nodes.label: Variance Audit & 5% Guard
nodes.description: Compares draft against previous paid cycle; flags variances > 5.00%; generates blocking issues requiring audit justification

nodes.label: Pay Run Lock State Machine
nodes.description: Advances Validated -> Locked; activates PostgreSQL trigger prevent_locked_pay_run_modification; locks all payslips & lines

nodes.label: MOHRE / CBUAE WPS SIF Generation
nodes.description: Generates standard WPS SIF file with Salary Control Record (SCR) and Employee Detail Record (EDR) using employer establishment ID

nodes.label: Disbursement & Payslip Release
nodes.description: Finance confirms bank transfer -> Status Paid; releases self-service payslips to /me/payslips with encrypted PDF download

nodes.label: Offboarding Clearance Checklist
nodes.description: Coordinates multi-department clearances (IT, Finance, Operations, HR); tracks company property return and handover tasks

nodes.label: Article 51/52 UAE Gratuity Engine
nodes.description: Calculates statutory End-of-Service Benefit based on contract type, separation reason (Resignation vs Termination), and exact service tenure

nodes.label: Account Archival Guard (T36)
nodes.description: Final settlement approval locks gratuity in DB via trigger; archives employee and disables login credentials permanently

nodes.label: Immutable Audit Ledger & Triggers
nodes.description: PostgreSQL database persisting immutable before/after diffs, user IDs, timestamps, and enforcing table-level data protection triggers

cards.title: UAE Statutory Compliance Framework
points: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021: Article 51 End-of-Service Gratuity (21 days/yr for first 5 yrs, 30 days/yr thereafter)
Overtime Multipliers: 1.25x Normal, 1.50x Night (10pm-4am) & Public Holidays
WPS SIF Format: Validates Ministry of Human Resources & Emiratisation Establishment ID & Central Bank routing
ISO-7064 MOD-97 checksum enforcement on all 23-character UAE IBANs
Dual-Control creator isolation on hiring (Creator cannot verify own recruit)

cards.title: Database Invariants & PostgreSQL Triggers
points: prevent_locked_pay_run_modification: Rejects any UPDATE or DELETE to payslips / payslip_lines in Locked or Paid state
prevent_final_settlement_modification: Enforces immutability on approved end-of-service financial settlements
T36 Archival Enforcement: Blocks user login immediately upon completion of final settlement
T4 SHA-256 Deduplication: Automatically rejects duplicate biometric files by cryptographic content hash
